name: Ank
description: Says he is the sheriff. Does not want me down there.

pages.text:
He was waiting in the upper caves, which is a strange place to wait.

He says the deep is dangerous, that there have been rock slides, that as sheriff my safety is his business. He will trade me almost anything to keep me above ground, and his prices make no sense.

A man who is that keen to sell me a reason to stay is a man with a reason of his own.
